d:
Miss Universe 2026 celebrated its 75th anniversary with a grand finale in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Puerto Rico's Jennifer Barreto was crowned Miss Universe 2026, becoming the first mother to win the prestigious title.
Dominican Republic's Melissa Núñez finished as the first runner-up, while Venezuela's Clara Vegas secured the second runner-up position.
India's representative Kaziah Liz Mejo made it to the Top 30 but could not advance to the Top 12. The 2026 edition also witnessed a major milestone as married women and mothers competed on the global stage.
